<subject>Succession Plan</subject>
<body>
Darren:
Congratulations on this well deserved appointment.  Your leadership has been a major factor in making Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd the leading company that it is and I am looking forward to seeing Tasman Ridge move to even greater heights under that leadership in the future.                       Congratulations again, Robert Smith
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by John Hunt on 
12/11/2024 10:10 AM ---------------------------

Robert Stanley
12/11/2024 06:02 AM


Sent by: Robert Schneider
To: All Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd Worldwide
cc: 

Subject: Succession Plan

It is my great pleasure to announce that the Board of Directors of Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd has accepted my recommendation to appoint Darren Richmond as chief executive officer, effective at the time of their next board meeting on 10 February 2025.  Darren will also retain his duties as president and chief operating officer.  I will continue as chairman of the Board of Directors and will remain at Tasman Ridge, working with Darren on the strategic direction of the company and our day-to-day global operations.

Darren will assume the role at a time when the company is hitting on all cylinders and is positioned for phenomenal growth.  He is clearly ready for the job, and after 15 years as CEO of this great company, I'm ready for a somewhat different role.

Our succession plan has been clear for some time.  This has afforded Darren and me the freedom to combine our strengths toward building a company that continues to exceed everyone's expectations, including our own.  We look forward to furthering that relationship as Darren expands his role.

There are no plans for any other changes in our management team nor broad shifts in strategy and direction.

Please join me in congratulating Darren.  I look forward to a great future.
John Hunt
Specialist
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
Phone: +61 8 9232 1111
</quoted>
